PluginData.Author: CometWorks
PluginData.Tooltip: Server rules of the Octahedron world
PluginData.Description: Server rules that only the Octahedron world uses: the economy stations' refill, refill containers, braking at the world's edge, starter ships from the stations' hologram tables, block limits for welded projections, a PCU cap per ship or station, shipyard welding in the stations' safe zones, ships ordered from the shipyards, a real account for the stations' faction with a daily wealth tax and an hourly dividend, its prices and stock at the stations' Store blocks, contracts posted and paid by that faction, a partitioning-friendly spawn pattern for Modular Encounters Systems, and (on hold) the NPC encounters spawned from the plugin's own blueprints.
